messages:
mia_finance: FYI Customer: AtlasScale flagged a billing anomaly on INV-2026-998. They believe a trial promo was not applied to a bulk embedding batch and requested an invoice adjustment.

trevor_sales: What's the requested amount and the reason? Do we have the promo code / contract reference?

mia_finance: Summary:
invoice: INV-2026-998
period: 2026-04-01 to 2026-04-30
billed_amount: $37,450.00
expected_with_promo: $22,500.00
discrepancy: $14,950.00
claimed_cause: promo code TRIAL-Q2-EMB not applied due to legacy pricing path; customer applied promo during onboarding.

maya_engineering: Confirmed embedding job used new billing metric path that missed promo tag on 2026-04-05. We recreated run with promo tag and numbers match customer's expected billing. I've attached export lines and a checksum for the affected batches in the ticket.

sam_legal: Contract SOW exhibit B shows a promotional credit for the first 1M embedding units for pilot customers, but the promo redemption workflow requires capture at activation. If the customer can demonstrate activation within the stated window, we can consider remedial credit. Need sales confirmation of activation timestamp.

zara_ops: Ops note: we patched the promo capture on 2026-05-02. No other customers were affected per sampling.

carlos_fd: finance policy: non-recoverable platform errors that lead to missed promotional credits can be approved up to $10k by finance; amounts above $10k require VP approval. We can do a partial immediate credit and then escalate.

mia_finance: Proposed path: 1) apply $10,000 one-time credit now (Billing team) 2) require AtlasScale to sign a short acknowledgement confirming activation window and accept statement of work amendment for future promos 3) escalate remaining $4,950 to VP for approval once customer signs.

trevor_sales: AtlasScale is receptive to signing the acknowledgement quickly. I'll send the note and ask for an e-sign today. If they sign, please queue the $10k credit.

BillingBot: CREDIT_QUEUE created: ref=CR-2623456789-1 amount=10000 status=pending linked_invoice=INV-2026-998

sam_legal: I'll draft a one-paragraph amendment and ping legal ops to enable simple e-sign. Draft will reference promo TRIAL-Q2-EMB and include a clause that future promo claims must be raised within 30 days of activation.

carlos_fd: please include finance in the routing. If VP approval needed, cc me.

mia_finance: Action list: trevor to get customer acknowledgement today; maya to add export to support ticket; sam to draft amendment; finance to apply provisional $10k once trevor confirms. I'll create a follow-up thread for VP approval on the remainder if needed.

trevor_sales: on it. Sending the draft note now.

mia_finance: thanks team, marking this as high-priority. Update thread when credit applied or customer signs.
